commit c9852dce7c4caf925bc98d4bb80763d4b1875749
Author: Tiago Vilas Boas <tcarvalhovb@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Nov 20 22:43:44 2026 -0300

    chore: move the Cursor quota bridge extension out of internal/ (#192)
    
    ## What
    
    - The Cursor quota bridge moves from `internal/cursorbridge` to
    `extensions/cursor-quota-bridge`. It is a JS extension plus a Python
    packaging script, with no Go code.
    - CI (`node --test`), the extension README, the packaging usage line,
    `docs/guides/quota.md`, the coverage table, the frozen-packages list and
    the architecture diagram now use the new path.
    - The workflow lint in pre-commit fails on any staged `ci.yml`, so this
    also clears the existing shellcheck findings there:
      - the `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` writes are grouped into one block;
    - the intentional `$pkgs` word splitting is marked with `# shellcheck
    disable=SC2086`.
    
    ## Why
    
    The owner decided to move it as part of the freeze
    (`docs/reference/frozen-packages.md`). `internal/` is for Go packages.
    
    ## Testing
    
    - `node --test
    extensions/cursor-quota-bridge/extension/decoder.test.cjs` passes 5 of
    5.
    - `python3 extensions/cursor-quota-bridge/package.py out.vsix` builds
    the VSIX. The script finds the root `LICENSE` at the same depth as
    before.
    - `make check` runs the full suite, because `ci.yml` changed. The
    workflow lint passes.
    
    ## Impact
    
    The path changes for anyone who packages the extension by hand. There is
    no runtime change.
    
    ## Checklist
    
    - [x] Docs updated
    
    ## Licence notice
    
    By contributing, I license this contribution under Apache 2.0.

 ## Enforcement
 
 Today this list is a review rule. Roadmap F3 adds an archtest check that fails
 when new code imports a frozen package from a new caller without an exception.
